name: Courthouse Row office
courthouse: Wendlow County Circuit Court: 3 minutes on foot
summary: Litigation, appeals and construction. Across the square from the county courthouse.
body: Conference rooms on the third floor, a trial war room, and a quiet room for clients waiting on a verdict. Street parking on the square; a garage on Tanner Street.

name: Mill District office
hours: Mon–Fri 8:30–5:30|Signing meetings on Saturday mornings by appointment
courthouse: Wendlow County Probate Court: 10 minutes on foot
summary: Business, trademarks, real estate and estate planning, in a converted mill on the river.
body: Ground-floor meeting rooms with step-free access and a parking lot behind the building. Estate plan signings happen here, with witnesses and a notary on staff.
